promptSummary: Bakery: Dos Rios Panaderia, Chicago IL (dos-rios-panaderia.example). Does this bakery already take online orders? Find: how customers place an order today, how many locations it runs, and who owns or manages it. Cite the page you took each fact from.
teachingNote: One tool, used once. The model asks for the home page, the build runs the tool, the text comes back, and the model answers from it. Every fact now has a URL behind it. For this bakery the home page says nothing about ordering, and the model reports NOT FOUND instead of filling the gap with a guess.

modelTurns.assistantText: I need the bakery's own words. I will read https://dos-rios-panaderia.example/ first.

From the Dos Rios Panaderia home page (https://dos-rios-panaderia.example/): Dos Rios Panaderia is "a family panaderia in the South Shore part of southeast Chicago," open Monday to Friday 6am to 7pm, Saturday 6am to 8pm and Sunday 6am to 3pm. Locations: the page gives one address, 32 Example Street, Chicago, IL 60649, and says "Dos Rios has been in the same spot, under the same family, since 2009." Who runs it: the home page says "one family" but names nobody; it points to an About page (https://dos-rios-panaderia.example/about) that I have not read. How orders are taken: NOT FOUND on this page. The home page lists a phone number, 312-555-0123, hours, photos and what is baked, and it shows a whole tres leches cake and a large rosca de reyes, but it has no order button, no cart, no link to an ordering service, and no sentence saying to call, email or come in to place an order. It does not say the bakery takes online orders and it does not say the bakery does not. From one page I cannot answer the question; the Menu page (https://dos-rios-panaderia.example/menu) is the next place I would look.
